entities.name: Cauldron of Eternity
entities.description: Magical stone bowl on Eldraine that grants eternal youth and can revive those it deems worthy.

entities.name: Eldraine
entities.description: Plane on which the Cauldron is found.

entities.name: Locthwain
entities.description: Court of Eldraine that once housed the Cauldron.

entities.name: The Wilds
entities.description: Region of Eldraine where Locthwain knights quested for the Cauldron.

entities.name: Will Kenrith
entities.description: Planeswalker whose persistence summoned the Cauldron back.

entities.name: Garruk Wildspeaker
entities.description: Planeswalker cursed by the Chain Veil, freed and revived by the Cauldron.

entities.name: Chain Veil
entities.description: Artifact whose curse afflicted Garruk Wildspeaker.

events.summary: The Cauldron vanished from Locthwain, and knights of that court quested in the Wilds to find it.
events.quote: many knights of that court have quested in the Wilds

events.summary: Will Kenrith's persistence summoned the Cauldron back, and it freed Garruk of the Chain Veil's curse and returned him to life.
events.quote: the Cauldron was used to free Garruk Wildspeaker of the Chain Veil 's curse and to return him to life
A voice that squeezed the heart called Garruk worthy

relations.note: It used to be housed at Locthwain.
relations.quote: It used to be housed at Locthwain before it vanished

relations.note: A magical artifact found on Eldraine.
relations.quote: a magical artifact found on the plane of Eldraine

relations.note: Garruk was cursed by the Chain Veil.
relations.quote: free Garruk Wildspeaker of the Chain Veil 's curse
